title: Late-binding closures
prompt: Type exactly what this program prints.

code.python:
funcs = [lambda: i * 10 for i in range(3)]
print([f() for f in funcs])

fixed = [lambda i=i: i * 10 for i in range(3)]
print([f() for f in fixed])

total = 0
for i in range(4):
    total += i
print(i, total)

hints: A closure looks up the variable when it is called, not when it is created.
A default argument captures the value at definition time.
